instagram.caption:
How to respond to reviews for your HVAC, plumbing or electrical business, good ones and bad ones.
Clear Seas Research with The ACHR News (HVAC trade paper, Sept 2024): 91% of 400 homeowners rate online reviews as an important factor when choosing an HVAC contractor; 56% use Google to find reviews.
Among the contractors surveyed: 45% answer reviews on third-party sites, 43% don't, 13% don't know.

Reviews Clinic, Lesson 7. Two replies to copy (examples):
Five stars: "Thanks for trusting us with your [job]. Glad it's running right. We're here when you need us."
One star: "Sorry we [fell short]. That's on us. I want to make it right. Call me directly at the shop."

Answer the bad ones too: short, calm, details offline, never argue in public.
One honest note: the survey shows reviews matter to homeowners. It doesn't prove a reply wins the job. Block 10 minutes every Monday.

Send this to whoever runs your Google profile.

youtube.title: How to Respond to Reviews for Your HVAC Business (Two Replies to Copy)
youtube.description:
How to respond to reviews for your HVAC business: one reply for five stars, one for one star.
For HVAC, plumbing, electrical and home service business owners.
The ACHR News, "91% of Homeowners Rely on Online Reviews Before Picking Contractors" (Dylan Kurt, Sep 17, 2024), a study by Clear Seas Research with The ACHR News: 91% of 400 homeowners rate online reviews as an important factor when choosing an HVAC contractor; 56% use Google to seek out reviews of contractors. Among the contractors surveyed, 45% answer reviews on third-party sites, 43% don't and 13% don't know; contractors with 1 to 10 employees were the least likely to answer. https://www.achrnews.com/articles/155206-91-of-homeowners-rely-on-online-reviews-before-picking-contractor

Two replies to copy (examples):
1. Five stars: "Thanks for trusting us with your [job]. Glad it's running right. We're here when you need us."
2. One star: "Sorry we [fell short]. That's on us. I want to make it right. Call me directly at the shop."
Answer the bad ones too: short, calm, details offline, never argue in public. Block 10 minutes every Monday for new reviews.
The survey shows reviews matter to homeowners; it doesn't prove a reply wins the job.

Send this to whoever runs your Google profile.
